litigation.mdlName: In re: Cook Medical, Inc., IVC Filters Marketing, Sales Practices and Products Liability Litigation
litigation.court: U.S. District Court, Southern District of Indiana

phase: Active MDL; Tulip bellwether selection and individual case administration
phaseDetail: JPML lists MDL-2570 as active before Senior Judge Richard L. Young. The court's June 2025 Case Management Order 34 created a second bellwether pool for Günther Tulip cases while the MDL continues to administer thousands of individual actions.

settlements.label: No MDL-wide settlement program identified in reviewed records
settlements.detail: The Southern District of Indiana MDL page and official records reviewed September 22, 2026 do not announce a global settlement program, universal compensation matrix, or payment deadline. An individual settlement or verdict does not set the value of another case.
settlements.individualClaims: No universal Cook IVC filter payment amount is verified here.
settlements.source: Southern District of Indiana MDL-2570 page

keyDates.label: MDL-2570 established
keyDates.detail: JPML centralized federal Cook IVC filter cases in the Southern District of Indiana before Judge Richard L. Young.

keyDates.label: Second Tulip bellwether plan entered
keyDates.detail: Case Management Order 34 established a process for forming a pool of eligible Günther Tulip cases and selecting cases for trial dates.
keyDates.source: Southern District of Indiana, Case Management Order 34

keyDates.label: 6,501 actions pending
keyDates.detail: JPML reports 6,501 pending actions and 11,478 historical actions in MDL-2570.

updates.summary: The official MDL page continues to list MDL-2570 before Senior Judge Richard L. Young; reviewed public records do not announce an MDL-wide settlement program.
JPML reports 6,501 pending actions and 11,478 historical actions, compared with 6,537 pending and 11,474 historical actions on August 3.
The court entered a second Günther Tulip bellwether plan to form a pool and select cases for future trial dates.
